item.title: Newbliss farmer: Eliminating badgers 'not an option'
item.description: A Co. Monaghan farmer is “hoping” that TB proposals introduced by the Department of Agriculture in 2025, will be implemented this year. David Hall, from Newbliss, has been elected as the IFA’s new animal health chair. He believes that the department’s TB plan has to be implemented, and highlighted that the Minister for Agriculture, Martin Heydon, has made a commitment to wildlife development. item.title: Clones volunteer group plays vital role during funerals
item.description: A group of volunteers in Clones have set up a group to close the main street to allow for funerals to pass through. The Clones Funeral Stewards Group was established in 2022. Traditionally, funerals go down Fermanagh St. in Clones. item.title: 'Children with additional needs in Monaghan continue to be failed'
item.description: A local father has raised his concerns over the lack of progress made to source a site for a permanent special needs school in Monaghan. Two years on from an initial promise by Government, Paddy McAloon says there is still no site picked. Paddy McAloon is a member of Special Needs Active Parents or SNAP, a Monaghan based campaign group of parents who have children with special needs. item.title: 40% of Q4 Monaghan house sales due to landlords selling
item.description: The house prices in Co Monaghan are rising. That's according to a new national survey released by Real Estate Alliance. The price of the average second-hand three-bed semi in County Monaghan rose to €250,000 in 2025 Advertisement That's up 6.4pc, from €235,000 at the end of 2024. Across the county, the average time taken to sell this quarter was four weeks, the Q4 REA Average House Price Index shows. item.title: Carrickmacross Toy Library announces new partnership
item.description: Carrickmacross Toy Library has announced a new partnership with Kingspan. It has funded a pilot schools outreach project through its Planet Passionate Communities Fund. The fund is a community-support initiative linked to Kingspan's wider Planet Passionate sustainability programme, backing local projects that benefit both people and the planet. item.title: Road closed near Virginia following collision
item.description: Emergency services are currently at the scene of a collision near Virginia. The L3022 from Ryefield to Oldcastle is currently closed, following a road traffic collision. Diversions are currently in place and Gardai are asking motorists to avoid the area at this time. Advertisement
